mcp.tool.bug_report.desc: Submit a bug report to VOKO developers or view reports and progress for the signed-in email. Never include secrets.
mcp.tool.bug_report.p.action: submit creates a report; query retrieves the current user's report history, status, and developer replies
mcp.tool.bug_report.p.title: Short bug title; required for submit
mcp.tool.bug_report.p.description: What went wrong; required for submit. Do not include secrets
mcp.tool.bug_report.p.severity: Severity: low, medium, high, or critical
mcp.tool.bug_report.p.category: Category: bug, crash, ui, performance, compatibility, or other
mcp.tool.bug_report.p.ownerEmail: Optional contact email for an anonymous report; later sign up or sign in with the same email to view its progress
web.bug_report.title: Report a bug
web.bug_report.intro: Send a problem to the VOKO developers. Do not include passwords, tokens, private keys, verification codes, or private conversation content.
web.bug_report.field.title: Title
web.bug_report.field.email_help: Anonymous reports may omit this. If supplied, sign up or sign in to VOKO with the same email to view its history and progress.
web.bug_report.severity.critical: Critical — crash, data, or security issue
web.bug_report.no_history: No bug reports have been submitted by this email yet.
web.bug_report.auto_history: No report ID or private credential is needed. View every report submitted by the current email under Check progress.
